listing.name: NHL Legacy Edition — NHL Legacy Remaster (megarohas)
listing.summary: This combines a port with a 2026/27 mod suite. The README does not establish complete gameplay coverage. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own unmodified title 454109EC disc or GOD files without title updates, including default.xex and approximately 6 GB of BIG data. The documented SHA256 is abbreviated here as d818eb15...c55624; use the full digest in the project’s documentation to check your copy.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build from source with ReXGlue0.10.0.24, the custom SDK, VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja and VulkanSDK. Roster and asset mods use a separate preparation process. The recorded review did not find a public release.

warnings: This combines a port with a 2026/27 mod suite. The README does not establish complete gameplay coverage.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
